learn.rule: An appositive is a noun phrase that renames the noun beside it. Set it off with a comma before and a comma after.
learn.ruleEs: Un appositive (aposición) es una frase nominal que renombra al sustantivo que tiene al lado. Se separa con una coma antes y una coma después.
learn.model: Marie Curie, a physicist and chemist, won Nobel Prizes in two different sciences.
learn.notice: The phrase a physicist and chemist renames Marie Curie. Look for the comma before it and the comma after it.

items.prompt: Which appositive best completes the sentence about Jupiter?
items.text: Jupiter, ___, has a storm that has lasted for centuries.

options.text: which is very large
is a gas giant
the largest planet in our solar system

items.why: An appositive renames the noun with another noun phrase. The largest planet in our solar system is another name for Jupiter.
items.whyEs: Un appositive renombra el sustantivo con otra frase nominal. The largest planet in our solar system es otro nombre para Jupiter.

items.prompt: Which sentence puts the appositive next to the noun it renames?

options.text: Mitochondria produce energy, the powerhouses of the cell.
The powerhouses of the cell, mitochondria produce energy.
Mitochondria, the powerhouses of the cell, produce energy.

items.why: The appositive must sit right beside the noun it renames. The powerhouses of the cell renames mitochondria, not energy.
items.whyEs: El appositive debe estar justo al lado del sustantivo que renombra. The powerhouses of the cell renombra a mitochondria, no a energy.

items.prompt: Choose the punctuation that sets off the appositive about Darwin.
parts: sailed on the HMS Beagle in 1831.
items.model: Charles Darwin, a naturalist and writer, sailed on the HMS Beagle in 1831.
items.why: An appositive in the middle of a sentence needs a comma on both sides, like a pair of parentheses.
items.whyEs: Un appositive en medio de una oración necesita una coma a cada lado, como un par de paréntesis.

items.prompt: Choose the appositive with correct commas for chlorophyll.
items.model: Chlorophyll, the green pigment in leaves, absorbs sunlight for photosynthesis.
items.why: The appositive the green pigment in leaves renames chlorophyll, so it needs commas before and after.
items.whyEs: El appositive the green pigment in leaves renombra a chlorophyll, así que necesita comas antes y después.

items.prompt: Check every sentence with a correctly punctuated appositive.

options.text: Albert Einstein, a theoretical physicist, developed the theory of relativity.
Albert Einstein a theoretical physicist, developed the theory of relativity.
The Amazon, the largest tropical rainforest on Earth, helps regulate Earth's climate.
My teacher, Ms. Alvarez teaches earth science.
Rosalind Franklin, a chemist, captured an important image of DNA.

items.why: A correct appositive has a comma on both sides of the renaming phrase. The wrong sentences are missing one of the two commas.
items.whyEs: Un appositive correcto tiene una coma a cada lado de la frase que renombra. A las oraciones incorrectas les falta una de las dos comas.

items.prompt: Which sentence joins the two Mars facts with an appositive?
items.text: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun. Mars has the tallest volcano in the solar system.

options.text: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, it has the tallest volcano in the solar system.
Mars, has the tallest volcano in the solar system, the fourth planet from the Sun.
Mars, the fourth planet from the Sun, has the tallest volcano in the solar system.

items.why: The first fact becomes an appositive tucked beside Mars, and the second fact stays as the main sentence.
items.whyEs: El primer dato se convierte en un appositive junto a Mars, y el segundo dato queda como oración principal.

write.prompt: Add an appositive after Jane Goodall to tell who she is. Put commas before and after it.
write.promptEs: Agrega un appositive después de Jane Goodall para decir quién es. Pon comas antes y después.
write.text: Jane Goodall studied chimpanzees in Tanzania.
write.frame: Jane Goodall, ___, studied chimpanzees in Tanzania.

label: I added an appositive between two commas
Agregué una aposición entre dos comas

write.model: Jane Goodall, a primatologist from England, studied chimpanzees in Tanzania for decades.

familyTalk.en: Tell about a person you admire. Say their name, then rename them with an appositive, like 'My aunt, a nurse, ...'
familyTalk.es: Hablen de una persona que admiren. Digan su nombre y luego renómbrenla con un appositive, como 'My aunt, a nurse, ...'

teacherTip.en: Ask students to cover the appositive with a finger; the sentence should still make sense without it.
teacherTip.es: Pide que tapen el appositive con un dedo; la oración debe seguir teniendo sentido sin él.

sets.title: Ancient Egypt, Renamed
sets.titleEs: El antiguo Egipto con otro nombre

learn.rule: An appositive is a noun phrase that renames the noun beside it. Set it off with a comma before and a comma after.
learn.ruleEs: Un appositive (aposición) es una frase nominal que renombra al sustantivo que tiene al lado. Se separa con una coma antes y una coma después.
learn.model: The Nile, the longest river in Africa, supplied water for ancient Egyptian farms.
learn.notice: The Nile and the longest river in Africa name the same thing. Commas wrap the appositive.

items.prompt: Which appositive best completes the sentence about Cleopatra?
items.text: Cleopatra VII, ___, ruled Egypt for about two decades.

options.text: who was very clever
the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic dynasty
became queen of Egypt

items.why: An appositive renames the person with a noun phrase. The last active ruler of the Ptolemaic dynasty is another way to name Cleopatra.
items.whyEs: Un appositive renombra a la persona con una frase nominal. The last active ruler of the Ptolemaic dynasty es otra forma de nombrar a Cleopatra.

items.prompt: Which sentence puts the appositive beside the noun it renames?

options.text: Egyptians built the pyramids at Giza, large stone tombs.
Large stone tombs, Egyptians built the pyramids at Giza.
Egyptians built the pyramids, large stone tombs, at Giza.

items.why: Large stone tombs renames the pyramids, so it belongs right after the pyramids. In the first choice it ends up next to Giza.
items.whyEs: Large stone tombs renombra a the pyramids, así que va justo después. En la primera opción queda junto a Giza.

items.prompt: Choose the punctuation that sets off the appositive about Hatshepsut.

options: one of Egypt's most successful pharaohs,
, one of Egypt's most successful pharaohs,
, one of Egypt's most successful pharaohs
parts.answer: , one of Egypt's most successful pharaohs,

parts: sent a trading expedition to the land of Punt.
items.model: Hatshepsut, one of Egypt's most successful pharaohs, sent a trading expedition to the land of Punt.
items.why: Both commas are needed. The first one opens the appositive and the second one closes it.
items.whyEs: Se necesitan las dos comas. La primera abre el appositive y la segunda lo cierra.

items.prompt: Choose the appositive with correct commas for the Rosetta Stone.
items.model: The Rosetta Stone, a granodiorite slab found in 1799, helped scholars read Egyptian hieroglyphs.
items.why: The slab found in 1799 renames the Rosetta Stone. A comma must come before and after the phrase.
items.whyEs: El slab found in 1799 renombra a la Rosetta Stone. Debe haber una coma antes y después de la frase.

items.prompt: Check every sentence about Egypt that has a correctly punctuated appositive.

options.text: Memphis, an early capital of Egypt, stood near the Nile Delta.
Tutankhamun a young pharaoh, became famous after his tomb was found in 1922.
Howard Carter, a British archaeologist, discovered Tutankhamun's tomb.
The pharaoh Ramses II, ruled Egypt for sixty-six years.
Papyrus, a tall reed that grows along the Nile, was made into paper.

items.why: The correct sentences wrap the renaming phrase in two commas. The wrong ones have only one comma or none at all.
items.whyEs: Las oraciones correctas rodean la frase con dos comas. Las incorrectas tienen solo una coma o ninguna.

items.prompt: Which sentence combines the two facts about Alexandria with an appositive?
items.text: Alexandria was a major seaport. Alexandria was founded by Alexander the Great.

options.text: Alexandria a major seaport was founded by Alexander the Great.
Alexandria, a major seaport, was founded by Alexander the Great.
Alexandria was a major seaport, was founded by Alexander the Great.

items.why: Turn one fact into an appositive (a major seaport) and keep the other as the main idea. Remember the two commas.
items.whyEs: Convierte un dato en appositive (a major seaport) y deja el otro como idea principal. Recuerda las dos comas.

write.prompt: Add an appositive after Ramses II to tell who he was. Put commas before and after it.
write.promptEs: Agrega un appositive después de Ramses II para decir quién fue. Pon comas antes y después.
write.text: Ramses II built temples along the Nile.
write.frame: Ramses II, ___, built temples along the Nile.

label: I added an appositive between two commas
Agregué una aposición entre dos comas

write.model: Ramses II, a pharaoh who ruled for sixty-six years, built great temples along the Nile.

familyTalk.en: Pick a famous place or person from history and rename it with an appositive, like 'Cairo, a city on the Nile, ...'
familyTalk.es: Elijan un lugar o una persona famosa de la historia y renómbrenlo con un appositive, como 'Cairo, a city on the Nile, ...'

teacherTip.en: Have students underline the noun and the appositive in two colors to show that both name the same thing.
teacherTip.es: Pide que subrayen el sustantivo y el appositive con dos colores para mostrar que ambos nombran lo mismo.

sets.title: Math Words, Renamed
sets.titleEs: Palabras de matemáticas con otro nombre

learn.rule: An appositive is a noun phrase that renames the noun beside it. Set it off with a comma before and a comma after.
learn.ruleEs: Un appositive (aposición) es una frase nominal que renombra al sustantivo que tiene al lado. Se separa con una coma antes y una coma después.
learn.model: A ratio, a comparison of two quantities, can be written as a fraction.
learn.notice: The phrase a comparison of two quantities explains the word ratio. Commas come before and after it.

items.prompt: Which appositive best completes the sentence about the number 17?
items.text: The number 17, ___, has exactly two factors.

options.text: because it is prime
a prime number
is a prime number

items.why: A prime number is a noun phrase that renames 17. The other choices are a reason or a verb phrase.
items.whyEs: A prime number es una frase nominal que renombra a 17. Las otras opciones son una razón o una frase verbal.

items.prompt: Which sentence about rectangles puts the appositive beside the noun it renames?

options.text: A rectangle has equal opposite sides, a four-sided shape with four right angles.
A rectangle, a four-sided shape with four right angles, has equal opposite sides.
A four-sided shape with four right angles, a rectangle has equal opposite sides.

items.why: A four-sided shape with four right angles renames a rectangle, so it goes right after the word rectangle.
items.whyEs: A four-sided shape with four right angles renombra a a rectangle, así que va justo después de la palabra rectangle.

items.prompt: Choose the punctuation that sets off the appositive about Katherine Johnson.
parts: calculated flight paths for early space missions.
items.model: Katherine Johnson, a NASA mathematician, calculated flight paths for early space missions.
items.why: A NASA mathematician renames Katherine Johnson in the middle of the sentence, so it needs commas on both sides.
items.whyEs: A NASA mathematician renombra a Katherine Johnson en medio de la oración, así que necesita comas a ambos lados.

items.prompt: Choose the appositive with correct commas for the median.

options: the middle value in a data set,
, the middle value in a data set,
, the middle value in a data set
parts.answer: , the middle value in a data set,

parts: is not affected by one extreme number.
items.model: The median, the middle value in a data set, is not affected by one extreme number.
items.why: The middle value in a data set renames the median. Put a comma before it and a comma after it.
items.whyEs: The middle value in a data set renombra a the median. Pon una coma antes y una coma después.

items.prompt: Check every math sentence that has a correctly punctuated appositive.

options.text: The mean, the sum of the values divided by the number of values, describes the average.
An integer a whole number or its opposite, can be negative.
The coordinate plane, a grid formed by two number lines, helps us graph points.
My teacher, Mr. Okafor shows us a new strategy.
Percent, a ratio out of one hundred, is used for discounts and data.

items.why: Each correct sentence has two commas around a renaming phrase. The incorrect ones are missing a comma.
items.whyEs: Cada oración correcta tiene dos comas alrededor de una frase que renombra. A las incorrectas les falta una coma.

items.prompt: Which sentence joins the two facts about Eratosthenes with an appositive?
items.text: Eratosthenes was a Greek scholar. Eratosthenes estimated the size of Earth.

options.text: Eratosthenes a Greek scholar estimated the size of Earth.
Eratosthenes, a Greek scholar, estimated the size of Earth.
Eratosthenes, estimated the size of Earth, a Greek scholar.

items.why: Place the appositive right after the name it renames, and wrap it in commas.
items.whyEs: Coloca el appositive justo después del nombre que renombra, y enciérralo entre comas.

write.prompt: Add an appositive after unit rate to explain what it is. Put commas before and after it.
write.promptEs: Agrega un appositive después de unit rate para explicar qué es. Pon comas antes y después.
write.text: A unit rate helps shoppers compare prices.
write.frame: A unit rate, ___, helps shoppers compare prices.

label: I added an appositive between two commas
Agregué una aposición entre dos comas

write.model: A unit rate, a rate with a denominator of one, helps shoppers compare prices fairly.

familyTalk.en: Pick a math word you know and rename it with an appositive, like 'A fraction, a part of a whole, ...'
familyTalk.es: Elijan una palabra de matemáticas y renómbrenla con un appositive, como 'A fraction, a part of a whole, ...'

teacherTip.en: Connect appositives to the glossary: students rewrite a vocabulary definition as an appositive inside a sentence.
teacherTip.es: Conecta los appositives con el glosario: los estudiantes reescriben una definición de vocabulario como appositive dentro de una oración.
